issue_context.title: Smarthome templates deleted in the FRITZ!Box UI are not removed from HomeAssistant
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When deleting a smarthome template ("Vorlage") from the FRITZ!Box, both the corresponding entity and device remain stale in HomeAssistant.

While the entity can be removed manually, the device is always present. Restart of HA or re-load of the integration does not solve this, removal and re-setup of the integration has not been checked.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.12.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

AVM FRITZ!SmartHome

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/fritzbox
